entries.name: Craft Anything
entries.summary: Agent-oriented environment for understanding software and building original alternatives.
entries.scope: General software; workflow inspiration.

entries.name: REA
entries.input: Authorized files, app behavior or binaries
entries.summary: Agent-assisted research across app behavior, web pages, runtimes, managed code and native binaries.
entries.scope: General software; workflow inspiration.

entries.name: AnyPS5
entries.summary: Experimental project exploring automated PS5 executable porting to Linux and Windows.
entries.scope: Linked as a research reference. No game content, firmware or keys are included.

entries.name: Ghidra
entries.summary: Extensible software reverse-engineering framework with broad processor support, scripting and debugging.
entries.scope: For binaries you may lawfully analyze.

entries.name: radare2
entries.summary: Portable framework and command-line toolset for binary analysis.
entries.scope: For authorized analysis targets.

entries.name: Rizin
entries.summary: Open-source reverse-engineering framework and command-line toolset.
entries.scope: For authorized analysis targets.

entries.name: Cutter
entries.summary: A graphical interface built around Rizin for interactive binary analysis.
entries.scope: For authorized analysis targets.

entries.name: x64dbg
entries.summary: Open-source user-mode debugger commonly used to inspect Windows applications.
entries.scope: Use with software you own or are authorized to debug.

entries.name: WinDbg
entries.summary: Microsoft debugger for user-mode and kernel-mode debugging, dumps and diagnostics.
entries.scope: Official documentation; follow applicable Microsoft terms.

entries.name: Frida
entries.summary: Dynamic instrumentation toolkit for developers, reverse engineers and security researchers.
entries.scope: No anti-cheat evasion or unauthorized service manipulation.

entries.name: ReClass.NET
entries.summary: Tool for exploring process data structures during debugging and authorized research.
entries.scope: Never target a third-party service or process without permission.

entries.name: ILSpy
entries.summary: Cross-platform .NET assembly browser and decompiler.
entries.scope: For assemblies you may lawfully inspect.

entries.name: dnSpyEx
entries.summary: Community-maintained .NET debugger and assembly editor.
entries.scope: Use only for authorized inspection and modification.

entries.name: JADX
entries.summary: Decompiler and GUI for Android DEX, APK and related formats.
entries.scope: Use with apps you own or have permission to inspect.

entries.name: UnityPy
entries.summary: Python library for parsing Unity serialized files and asset bundles.
entries.scope: Do not redistribute extracted copyrighted assets; follow the game's terms.

entries.name: AssetRipper
entries.summary: Open-source GUI application for analyzing Unity project files.
entries.scope: Only examine files you are authorized to access; do not share extracted content.

entries.name: AssetStudio
entries.summary: Explorer for Unity assets and asset bundles.
entries.scope: Use with files you are authorized to examine; respect copyright and EULAs.

entries.name: Kaitai Struct
entries.summary: Language and toolchain for describing binary data formats and generating parsers.
entries.scope: Use on lawfully obtained format samples.

entries.name: RenderDoc
entries.outputs: Frame captures and graphics pipeline inspection
entries.summary: Open-source graphics debugger for frame capture and graphics development.
entries.scope: Use on your own application or authorized test builds.

entries.name: Wireshark
entries.summary: Network protocol analyzer for troubleshooting and authorized protocol research.
entries.scope: Capture only traffic you are authorized to inspect; protect personal data.

entries.name: FEX
entries.summary: User-mode x86 and x86-64 emulator for ARM64 Linux.
entries.scope: Compatibility and preservation research on lawful software copies.

entries.name: Proton
entries.summary: Steam Play compatibility tool based on Wine and additional components.
entries.scope: Follow platform terms; use for compatibility research, not access-control bypass.

entries.name: Binary Ninja
entries.summary: Commercial reverse-engineering platform with an extensible analysis API.
entries.scope: Check current edition and license terms with the vendor.

entries.name: IDA
entries.summary: Commercial interactive disassembler and decompiler with free editions available from the vendor.
entries.scope: Check edition limitations and license terms with the vendor.

entries.name: capa
entries.summary: Open-source tool for identifying capabilities in executable files.
entries.scope: Defensive analysis and authorized research.
